notes:
I verified all 16 claims against W at cb398676 and edited no tracked file. Thirteen conform and three do not (S6c-001, S6c-002, S6c-004), all of class deviation.

The two mutability claims, S6c-001 and S6c-004, rest on two facts. First, the leaf walk never enters an opaque leaf (src/leaves.jl:105), so a handle with a Matrix field or a Tuple{Vector} port builds. This is the §4.4 handle pattern working as designed; it contradicts only the literal "anywhere" in spec:1003 and in D-237's Position. Second, a mutable Real such as BigFloat is admitted as a leaf (src/leaves.jl:100). The probe shows a BigFloat port builds and runs, and no log entry records that exemption.

S6c-002: the code lets a primitive define one stage or the other (has_stage). The spec's own §5.2 lines 1226 and 1259 already assume that a stage can be absent.
